entities.name: Al-Harith ibn Kalada
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Al-Hārith ibn Kalada was an Arab physician and is said to be one of a companion of the Islamic prophet Muhammad. Though scholars differed upon this opinion. He is said to have traveled to Gundeshapur in search of medical knowledge before the advent of Islam.
